name: Waist trainer

lead: A waist trainer is a tight, corset-style garment, usually elastic with rigid boning, worn around the midsection to compress it. Modern versions are marketed as a way to slim the waist over weeks of daily wear.
They are popular in image-focused social media, but the shape change is attributed to compression while worn rather than to fat loss.

paras: Compression temporarily squeezes soft tissue and shifts it above and below the garment, narrowing the waist silhouette. No mechanism for lasting reshaping of the ribcage or permanent fat loss has been established. A small physiologic study found reduced maximal breathing capacity while wearing a corset.

Reported issues include restricted breathing, discomfort, reflux and abdominal discomfort. In the one small study located, maximal voluntary ventilation fell while wearing a trainer, and a longer trial of waist trainers for weight control was inconclusive because participants found them too uncomfortable. Claims that waist training causes permanent fat loss or reshaping are not supported by published studies, and widely quoted figures on lost lung capacity do not trace to solid research.
